name: company-scrapper-service
description: Always-on API for the Researchers/Company Scrapper AI — reads/writes the live TiDB Cloud Starter business store and exposes an Apollo-style filtered/paginated company browser (GET /api/filters, GET /api/companies) plus radius trade-area search (/api/trade-area, /api/research). Real geocoding + real fuzzy category matching + the actual database queries are always deterministic; no LLM call anywhere in this service.
